answer_prose: For runners whose first slow section ended at 25 km, median arrival there was 98 minutes in the under-4-min/km early-pace group and 179 minutes in the 6-min/km-or-slower group. Distance and elapsed time describe different aspects; these observations do not identify the cause of slowing.
detail_prose: The timing mats locate the first slow section, not the exact instant the pace changed. This descriptive comparison cannot identify a distance-driven or time-driven cause.
